# notMyShell (NMSh)

notMyShell is a terminal frontend that runs on top of a real persistent shell instead of replacing the shell.

Shell backends (real persistent shells, via ShellAdapter):
- zsh (default), Fish, Bash 4.4+; /shell switches the current session in place

Platforms:
- macOS (supported)
- Linux (automated tests; physical validation pending)
- Windows only through WSL 2 (WSL 1 and native Windows unsupported)

Terminal hosts:
- intentionally terminal-host independent; no host is required or preferred
- integrated terminals (such as Zed and VS Code) and standalone terminals
  (such as Ghostty and macOS Terminal) are both first-class and regularly
  used during development and physical testing
- other compatible hosts are supported through capability profiles, some
  without the same level of physical validation

Core architecture:

Terminal host
→ NMSh frontend
→ ShellAdapter (zsh / Fish / Bash)
→ persistent real shell PTY

Product boundary: NMSh owns terminal-native interaction (composer,
completion menu, transcript, find/filter, sessions, history, prompt);
the editor around it owns editing, project search, rich diff and
navigation. NMSh bridges to it (/open, /open-diff) and does not clone it.

## Core capabilities

- fixed/persistent bottom input editor
- scrollable command and output history
- semantic syntax highlighting
- submitted commands retain semantic highlighting in history
- multiline editing
- shell-aware autocomplete/completion
- ghost/history suggestions
- real aliases, functions, environment, cwd and shell state
- command lifecycle/activity UI
- passthrough for fullscreen/interactive terminal programs
- /copy
- /history
- /appearance
- /keyboard
- zoxide integration
- Atuin/history bridge where accurate
- fzf/fullscreen passthrough where accurate
- cross-session notices and the /resume session viewer
- local-only agent activity stats (/agents) for Claude Code and Codex CLI
- /find and /filter over the transcript
- /open and /open-diff delegation to Zed, VS Code or $VISUAL/$EDITOR
- nmsh config export/import, nmsh uninstall, nmsh doctor
- capability-driven inline images (/about) with text fallback
- no plugin manager required; read-only framework/plugin diagnostics

## NMSh is NOT

- not a shell replacement
- not a terminal emulator
- not an AI shell
- not a command-by-command subprocess wrapper
- not a Warp clone
